Project.NAME: letopis
Project.keywords: temporal database, versioned entities, event history, postgres, timescaledb, hypertable, jsonb, graph traversal, chainable query, schema registry, fastest-validator, acl, authentication, sessions, redis
Project.annotation: letopis — a temporal, append-only versioned entity store over PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB with a chainable graph-query API, a DB-driven schema registry, and built-in authentication, ACL, and session support.

M-TYPES.NAME: Types
M-TYPES.purpose: Shared type vocabulary for the whole library: entities, paths, class definitions, filters, operators, and public option/result shapes

type-Row.PURPOSE: A versioned entity row: id, class, data, links, tags, account, owner, updated (+ $deleted/$depth markers)

type-Path.PURPOSE: Record<className, Row> — one traversed graph path

type-ClassDef.PURPOSE: Resolved schema class: category HUB|LINK, ancestors, attributes, link ends, id-gen, compiled check()

type-FieldType.PURPOSE: Discriminated field type used for SQL casting and aggregation

type-Filter.PURPOSE: Read filter: id(s), $tags op, or per-field scalar/array/Op predicates

type-Op.PURPOSE: Operator node { [OP]: name, args } produced by the ops builders

const-OP.PURPOSE: unique symbol tagging an operator node

type-PlanOp.PURPOSE: A queued write op: create|update|delete|anonymize with data/fields/confirm/mods

type-Resource.PURPOSE: ACL resource: alias, category, pattern, meta

type-Rule.PURPOSE: ACL rule: account, resource, permission, weight, enabled

type-AclDecision.PURPOSE: ACL outcome: allow, matched rule, row filter, code, message

type-QueryEvent.PURPOSE: Telemetry event delivered to the onQuery hook

type-ConnectOpts.PURPOSE: connect() options: dsn, schema, partition, account, enforce flags, onQuery, slowMs

M-UUID.NAME: Uuid
M-UUID.purpose: Deterministic (v5) and time-ordered (v7) UUID generation for entity ids

const-LETOPIS_NS.PURPOSE: Default UUIDv5 namespace for the library

fn-uuidv5.PURPOSE: Deterministic name-based UUID (sha1) within a namespace

M-SESSIONS.NAME: Sessions
M-SESSIONS.purpose: Session lifecycle over an injected Redis-shaped key/value store: start, check, revoke, revoke-all

fn-makeSessions.PURPOSE: Build a Sessions API bound to a SessionStore (sha256 token keys sess:*)

M-OPS.NAME: Ops
M-OPS.purpose: Filter-operator builders that produce Op nodes for the query filter DSL

fn-isOp.PURPOSE: Type guard: value is an Op node

M-SCHEMA.NAME: Schema
M-SCHEMA.purpose: Load the class registry from the DB Schema table, resolve inheritance/link ends, derive field types and compile per-class validators

class-Registry.PURPOSE: In-memory class registry: add/find/resolve/has over ClassDef by id and alias

fn-fieldTypeOf.PURPOSE: Map a fastest-validator attribute spec to a FieldType

fn-loadRegistry.PURPOSE: Query Schema rows for a partition and build a Registry of ClassDefs with compiled checks

M-TABLES.NAME: Tables
M-TABLES.purpose: Typed CRUD over the auth/authz tables: Account, Credential, Resource, Rule

fn-makeTables.PURPOSE: Build the Tables facade bound to a Ctx

M-ACL.NAME: Acl
M-ACL.purpose: Authorization engine: match subjects/resources, resolve winning rule by weight, produce allow/deny decisions and row filters for API endpoints and data-class operations

fn-matchCategories.PURPOSE: Match a resource category pattern against account categories

fn-makeAcl.PURPOSE: Build a runtime AclApi over Tables + Registry

fn-compileEnforcer.PURPOSE: Precompile an (ClassDef, op) → AclDecision enforcer for a given account+categories

fn-aclDenied.PURPOSE: Build the standard 'acl denies' Error for a denied op

M-AUTH.NAME: Auth
M-AUTH.purpose: Credential lifecycle and verification: passwords (scrypt), API keys, key+secret, TOTP, OTP, identity links, plus session issuance

fn-totpCode.PURPOSE: Compute the current TOTP code for a base32 secret (test/helper surface)

type-AuthResult.PURPOSE: { account, credential } returned by a successful verification

fn-makeAuth.PURPOSE: Build the AuthApi bound to Tables

M-SQL.NAME: Sql
M-SQL.purpose: Read-side SQL engine: the Ctx runtime context, filter/operator compilation to parameterized SQL, path-traversal read builder, query execution with telemetry and transient-error retry, and insert/delete/closure SQL builders

type-Ctx.PURPOSE: Runtime context: sql, registry, pgSchema, partition, account/owner, enforce flags, aclDecide, onQuery, slowMs

type-Step.PURPOSE: One compiled chain step: class, filter, node/pivot/alias keys, tag/account/owner/links filters, op

type-SlotValue.PURPOSE: Link-slot value: id | nested plan | null

type-BuiltQuery.PURPOSE: { text, params, keys } produced by buildRead

fn-buildRead.PURPOSE: Compile steps+mods into a parameterized read query (CTE path traversal)

fn-runQuery.PURPOSE: Execute a query, emit QueryEvent/slow-warn, classify+retry transient errors

fn-hintTxRetry.PURPOSE: Mark an error so the tx wrapper retries

fn-resolveHop.PURPOSE: Resolve forward/reverse traversal between two classes via Schema.links

fn-leafType.PURPOSE: Field type at a data path for casting

fn-linksTo.PURPOSE: Whether a class embeds a link end to a target

fn-nextNodeKey.PURPOSE: Monotonic node-key allocator for path aliasing

fn-entityTable.PURPOSE: Quoted Entity table name for a schema

M-WRITE.NAME: Write
M-WRITE.purpose: Write-side engine: validate against the class, resolve link ends/slots, compute v5/v7 ids, insert new versions, cascade delete, anonymize, and orchestrate multi-op plans and batches inside transactions

class-ValidationError.PURPOSE: Error carrying per-field validation issues for a class

fn-runPlan.PURPOSE: Execute a chain plan (segments of write ops + a read tail) and return the requested mode

fn-executeBatch.PURPOSE: Execute a queue of plans, fast-pathing pure inserts into one multi-insert

fn-toRow.PURPOSE: Normalize a raw DB row into a Row

fn-readRows.PURPOSE: Read rows for steps+mods (write-path read helper)

fn-createOp.PURPOSE: Insert a new entity (id fixing, v5 computation, slot resolution)

fn-updateOp.PURPOSE: Version an existing entity with a deep-merged patch

fn-delOp.PURPOSE: Tombstone + cascade delete with ACL checks

fn-anonymizeOp.PURPOSE: Erase string fields in place, tag 'anonymized'

fn-deepMerge.PURPOSE: Recursive object merge for update patches

M-TX.NAME: Tx
M-TX.purpose: Manual transaction handle and advisory locking over a reserved connection

type-TxCtx.PURPOSE: Ctx extended with commit()/rollback() on a reserved connection

fn-beginTx.PURPOSE: Reserve a connection and BEGIN a transaction

M-CHAIN.NAME: Chain
M-CHAIN.purpose: The chainable entity API: build class/link/pivot steps into read or write plans, expose run/rows/first/ids/count/aggregations, versions/asOf/after, create/update/delete/anonymize, link slots, batches, transactions, and change watching
M-CHAIN.depends: M-TYPES, M-SQL, M-WRITE, M-TX, M-TABLES, M-AUTH, M-ACL, M-SCHEMA

type-EntityDb.PURPOSE: Root db handle: class callables + begin/commit/rollback/batch/watch/close + auth/acl/tables/registry/sql

type-ChainCore.PURPOSE: Terminal + modifier methods on a chain (run/rows/first/ids/count/sort/limit/asOf/deep/agg/create/update/delete/…)

type-StepProp.PURPOSE: A class step property: callable navigation + set()/unset() link-slot ops

type-Batch.PURPOSE: Deferred multi-plan builder: run/discard/size + class callables

type-WatchEvent.PURPOSE: Change event { partition, class, id, updated, deleted }

const-PLAN.PURPOSE: unique symbol exposing a chain's internal plan for embedding

fn-makeDb.PURPOSE: Construct an EntityDb over a Ctx

M-CONNECT.NAME: Connect
M-CONNECT.purpose: Public package entry: open a connection (load registry, wire acl enforcement, build the db) and re-export the public surface; cursor helper
M-CONNECT.depends: M-SCHEMA, M-CHAIN, M-TABLES, M-ACL, M-SQL, M-TYPES, M-UP

fn-connect.PURPOSE: Connect to Postgres, load the schema registry for a partition, optionally enable enforceAcl, and return an EntityDb

fn-cursorOf.PURPOSE: Build a keyset Cursor from a row + field

notes.note-1: Barrel: re-exports up/UpOpts (M-UP), uuid* (M-UUID), ops* (M-OPS), totpCode/AuthApi/AuthResult (M-AUTH), AclApi (M-ACL), ValidationError (M-WRITE), Registry (M-SCHEMA), Session* (M-SESSIONS), core types (M-TYPES), chain/tables types.
notes.note-2: Runtime ESM cycle with M-UP: index re-exports up, up imports connect. Live bindings make this safe (no top-level use).

M-UP.NAME: Up
M-UP.purpose: Dev bootstrap: ensure a Docker Postgres+Redis container, ensure the database, apply the schema DDL and seeds, wait for readiness, then connect

fn-up.PURPOSE: Provision (docker) + apply DDL/seeds + connect; returns an EntityDb

fn-dockerRunArgs.PURPOSE: Build the 'docker run' argument vector for the dev container

type-UpOpts.PURPOSE: up() options: dsn, schema, version, container/image, dataDir, redisPort, seeds, fresh, quiet, waitTimeoutMs

M-DDL.NAME: Ddl
M-DDL.purpose: The PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB storage engine: Schema/Entity/Account/Credential/Resource/Rule tables, the Entity hypertable, and the plpgsql triggers that enforce validation, versioning-on-update, cascade tombstone-delete, lineage, and change notification

table-Entity.PURPOSE: Versioned entities hypertable (PK partition,class,id,updated; jsonb data/links; tags; account/owner; deleted)

fn-schema_lineage.PURPOSE: Trigger: maintain ancestors/descendants closure on Schema changes

fn-entity_check.PURPOSE: BEFORE INSERT trigger: validate class exists/non-abstract and link ends

fn-entity_update.PURPOSE: BEFORE UPDATE trigger: convert update into a new-version insert

fn-entity_delete.PURPOSE: BEFORE DELETE trigger: tombstone + recursive cascade of dependents (advisory-locked)

fn-entity_notify.PURPOSE: AFTER INSERT trigger: pg_notify change payload for watch()

M-SEED-AUTH.NAME: SeedAuth
M-SEED-AUTH.purpose: Idempotent seed of the System account and the default ACL Resource/Rule set for auth endpoints

seed-Rule.PURPOSE: 12 allow/deny rules with weights binding accounts to resources

M-SEED-BOOKING.NAME: SeedBooking
M-SEED-BOOKING.purpose: Idempotent seed of the Schema table for the demo booking domain — the source of truth for its classes

M-GEN-TYPES.NAME: GenTypes
M-GEN-TYPES.purpose: CLI codegen: read the Schema table for a schema and emit a typed .d.ts facade (per-class Data interfaces, TypedRow/TypedChain/TypedDb)

fn-ts.PURPOSE: Convert a fastest-validator attribute spec into a TypeScript type string

M-SCHEMA-SYNC.NAME: SchemaSync
M-SCHEMA-SYNC.purpose: CLI schema migration: diff a schema JSON file against the DB Schema table, re-validate a sample of live entities, and (with --apply) upsert class definitions

check-breaking.PURPOSE: Compile new strict validators and report live rows that would break before apply

M-DOCKER.NAME: Docker
M-DOCKER.purpose: Dev database container image: TimescaleDB pg17 plus a background Redis, used by letopis.up()

script-start.PURPOSE: start.sh: launch redis-server daemonized, then exec the postgres docker-entrypoint
